name: cloudflare-one
title_zh: Cloudflare One 零信任与 SASE 部
tagline_zh: 不用翻 200 页文档，直接问它：怎么配 Access 策略？Tunnel 连不上？
tagline_en: Skip the 200-page docs. Ask it: how to set Access policy? Tunnel down? Migrating from Zscaler? Get actionable.
desc_en: Design, configure, troubleshoot, or review Cloudflare One Zero Trust and SASE deployments. Use cloudflare-one-migrations for migration planning from other vendors.
why_zh: 它把 Cloudflare One 的配置逻辑和迁移路径内化成了决策树。
why_en: It internalizes Cloudflare One's config logic and migration paths into a decision tree, giving minimal-change plans, not generic.
limit_zh: 需要你已有 Cloudflare 账号和基础网络知识；不处理非 Cloudflare 产品的深度排障。
limit_en: Requires your Cloudflare account and basic networking knowledge; won't deep-troubleshoot non-Cloudflare products; configs not guaranteed to pass.
title_en: Cloudflare One Zero Trust & SASE config, troubleshoot.
